description: Search Europages for European manufacturers, wholesalers and service providers, or fetch specific company profiles.

category.description: A Europages product/service category name or slug to browse, e.g. `packaging`, `industrial valves`, `food-processing-equipment`. Used when `searchQueries` is empty.
category.title: Category (mode=category)

companyUrls.description: Europages company profile URLs or bare slugs, e.g. `https://www.europages.co.uk/en/company/weber-food-technology-se-co-kg-508813` or `weber-food-technology-se-co-kg-508813`.
companyUrls.title: Company profile URLs (mode=company)

countries.description: Only return suppliers located in these countries. Leave empty for all Europages countries.
countries.title: Supplier countries

employeeCounts.description: Only return suppliers in these employee-count bands. Leave empty for every company size.
employeeCounts.title: Employee range

includeDetails.description: Adds VAT ID, certificates, named contacts, product portfolio and categories by opening each company's profile page. Adds one request per company.
includeDetails.title: Open each company profile

maxItems.description: Maximum number of company records to return across all keywords and countries.
maxItems.title: Max suppliers

maxPages.description: Europages returns 30 companies per page and caps a single search at 100 pages (about 3,000 companies).
maxPages.title: Max result pages per keyword

mode.description: Search by keyword, browse a product category, browse a country, or fetch specific company profile URLs. Legacy mode names are accepted for saved tasks.
mode.title: Mode

partitionByCountry.description: When more than 3,000 suppliers are requested without a country filter, search each Europages country separately and deduplicate the results.
partitionByCountry.title: Split large searches by country

searchQueries.description: Product, service or industry keywords to search on Europages, e.g. `food processing equipment`, `packaging machinery`, `cnc machining`. Required for search, category and country modes. One search per keyword.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

sortBy.description: Relevance keeps Europages' own ranking; Distance sorts by distance from the proxy location.
sortBy.title: Sort order

supplierTypes.description: Only return suppliers with at least one of these business roles. Leave empty for every type.
supplierTypes.title: Supplier type

verifiedOnly.description: Only return companies whose Europages profile is verified.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified companies only

title: Europages European Supplier Finder Input
